text: RESOLVED: Timeline[A] is a neutral kernel value carrying one ClockId and ordered instantaneous Mark[A] values; equal timestamps are allowed and input order breaks ties. PlannedTimeline[A] and ObservedTimeline[A] are distinct, and realized-timing analyses require the observed form. Sync stays the affine transformation; SyncEvidence.fromCommonEvents fits offset-only or affine alignment from trigger pairs and returns observation count, residuals, RMS and maximum error. A one-pair offset fit is representable but visibly weaker than multi-trigger evidence. ASC and presentation-log importers land stimulus messages in an ObservedTimeline rather than ocular Event or an untyped Recording side channel. Rationale: planned schedules are not observations, clocks drift, and IO-2 otherwise has no typed destination.
